title: incident-bot: oncall runbook auto-diagnostics ranking and heuristics
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: on-call responders relying on incident-bot were getting long runbook suggestion lists with low signal. This change improves the auto-diagnostics pipeline to 1) score candidate runbooks using a lightweight heuristic ranker, 2) surface a condensed top-3 with rationale snippets, and 3) expose a config toggle for teams to prefer precision vs recall. Changes include algorithmic improvements, small UX updates to the on-call message format, unit tests, and docs. Checklist: - [x] implement heuristic ranker and scoring pipeline - [x] add top-3 condensation and rationale snippets - [x] add config flag (runbook_ranking_mode: precision|recall|balanced) - [x] tests covering ranking edgecases and VCR fixtures - [x] update incident-bot runbook docs and examples - [x] smoke test on staging Observability: added new metrics incident_bot.runbook_rank.delta_score and incident_bot.runbook_rank.top_k_coverage for measuring ranking effectiveness in canary. Rollout: feature gated behind runtime flag disabled by default; staged rollout to teams with incident-bot=v3.1. Backwards compatibility: when disabled behavior is identical to current runbook suggestions (no ranking).

review_comments: Jared Kim: Overall looks good. Can we keep the default as 'balanced' instead of 'precision'? Otherwise teams with sparse runbooks might lose coverage.
Priya Nair: Switched default to 'balanced' and added explicit tests for sparse-runbook coverage. Also added metric to track top_k_coverage so we can watch regressions.
Maya Thompson: In test_ranker I saw a flaky assertion tied to ordering when scores are equal. Suggest stable tiebreaker by timestamp or ID.
Priya Nair: Added deterministic tie-breaker (runbook ID) and updated tests. Reran unit tests locally and CI.
Elliot Park: CI showed an intermittent lint failure on import ordering. Minor, approved after fix.
Jared Kim: Approved after a smoke run on staging with the flag enabled for the ops team. Metrics look reasonable (delta_score median +0.18, top_3 coverage +12%).
